salon-rates.name: Salon Prices
salon-rates.one_liner: What everyone in your sector is charging for a given service.

steps.verb_object: says whether your price for a service is high or low for your area (My shop)
lists what shops near you charge for one service, filtered by size, stylist level and distance

pt-rates.name: PT Rates
pt-rates.one_liner: What everyone in your sector is charging for a given service.

steps.verb_object: shows what BCBS MN, HealthPartners and UCare pay one clinic, code by code
puts each code's rate next to the market median and the middle half of clinics
lists the market median per billing code across Twin Cities clinics

obsolete-parts.name: Legacy Requests (obsolete parts)
obsolete-parts.one_liner: Models demand from government RFPs. And supply from 3P vendors on places like ebay and online auction houses.

steps.verb_object: lists the makes and parts government agencies keep filing to buy, each linked to the agency's own filing
flags the same buyer asking for the same part number again, months or years apart
'Find it': links a part to listings for sale (eBay, GovDeals, PublicSurplus), its manual, and who services it
hands a dealer every agency that filed for a model the dealer has listed (/for/<token>/ pages)
